records.name: Item Collector I
records.text: For each unique item they are holding, your team gains @AD*100@% Attack Damage and @AP@% Ability Power.

records.name: Item Collector II
records.text: Your team gains @BaseHP@ Health. For each unique item they are holding, your team gains bonus @Health@ Health, @AD*100@% Attack Damage, and @AP@% Ability Power.

records.name: Solo Plate
records.text: Gain a Gargoyle Stoneplate. Combat start: Allies holding Gargoyle Stoneplate gain @HealthIncrease*100@% max Health if they're the only one in their row.

records.name: Spirit of Redemption
records.text: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every @Frequency@ seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within @HexRadius@ hex for @MissingHealth@% of their missing Health.

records.name: Indiscriminate Killer
records.text: Gain a Giant Slayer. Giant Slayers gain their Damage Amp against all enemies instead of just Tanks.

records.name: Kick Start
records.text: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost champion and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Last Second Save
records.text: The first time each ally falls below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, they restore @HealPercent*100@% maximum Health.

records.name: Late Game Scaling
records.text:
Gain @XPGain@ XP at the start of player combat rounds. Your 5-cost champions gain @BonusHealth*100@% Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Cyber City Tactician's Crown, 2025

records.name: Legion of Threes
records.text:
Gain a random Emblem. Your 3-cost champions and all allies equipped with an Emblem gain @HealthAmount@ Health and @AS*100@% Attack Speed.

Reckoning Championship, 2021

records.name: Lineup
records.text: Your team gains @Resistances@ Armor and Magic Resist for each ally that starts combat in the front two rows.

records.name: Luxury Subscription
records.text:
Gain a package containing a 5-cost champion, a 2-star 1-cost champion, and @Gold@ gold.

At the start of the next @FutureChampionCount@ stages, gain the package again.

records.name: A Magic Roll
records.text:
Roll 3 dice. Gain rewards based on their total.

Reward: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MagicRoll@

records.name: Slightly Magic Roll
records.text:
Roll a die. Gain rewards based on the number rolled.

Reward: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MagicRoll@

records.name: Focused Fire
records.text: Your team gains @BaselineAD*100@% Attack Damage. Every @ProcDelay@ seconds, they gain @ADPerProc*100@% more.

records.name: Max Build
records.text:
Gain a Champion Duplicator, @Gold@ gold, and your next shop contains 5 unique four-cost champions.

Galaxies Championship, 2020

records.name: Min-Max
records.text:
Gain a Golden Item Remover and @NumItems@ random components.

Golden Item Remover is a Magnetic Remover with infinite uses.

records.name: Malicious Monetization
records.text:
Gain @GoldContained@ gold. For the next @Rounds@ rounds, enemy champions drop @PercCost@ gold when killed.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MirroredMonetization_TotalGoldTooltip@

records.name: Misfits
records.text:
Your team gains @Health@ Health for each active Unique trait. Gain a Rhaast and a Miss Fortune.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_Misfits_TotalHealthTooltip@

Unique traits belong to 1 champion and are shown in orange.

records.name: Money Hungry
records.text: Gain @InstantGold@ gold now, then @StageGold@ gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

records.name: Money Monsoon
records.text: Gain @RoundGold@ gold now and every round for the rest of the game.

records.name: Moonlight
records.text: Combat start: @NumUnits@ random 1-cost champion is upgraded to 3-star for that round and gains @ADBonus*100@% Attack Damage and @APBONUS@% Ability Power.

records.name: Component Heist
records.text:
After @NumberOfCombats@ player combats, gain 1 of every item component. Gain a random component now.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MuseumHeist_TooltipTRAKey@ @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_MuseumHeist_CompleteTRAKey@

records.name: Nine Lives
records.text: Set your current and max player Health to @NumberOfLives@. On combat loss, you only lose @HealthLoss@ health and gain loot. You can't gain health.

records.name: NO SCOUT NO PIVOT
records.text:
Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your team gains @HPScale*100@% Health, and @APScale@% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_NoScoutNoPivot_TrackerTRAKEY_Holder@

records.name: Noble Sacrifice
records.text: When your first ally dies each combat, grant your team @BaseResists@ + @SharePerc*100@% of that ally's Armor and Magic Resistance.

records.name: One Buff, Two Buff
records.text: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

records.name: Overheal
records.text: Every third attack deals @BonusDamage*100@% damage and heals @PercentHeal*100@% of the damage. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to @MaxShield@ Health.

records.name: Patience is a Virtue
records.text: Gain @InitialRerolls@ rerolls now. Each round, gain @FreeRerolls@ free rerolls if you did not buy a champion last round.

records.name: Pilfer
records.text: Each round, gain a 1-star copy of the first champion you killed last combat. The first time you gain @GoldRequired@ gold worth of champions in this way, gain a Thief's Gloves. @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_Pilfer_Tooltip@

records.name: Placebo
records.text: Your team gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Placebo+
records.text: Your team gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed. Gain @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Plot Armor
records.text: Your team gains @BaseResists@ Armor and Magic Resist. After falling below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, increase this to @EnhancedTotalResists@ for the rest of combat.

records.name: Pocket Recombobulator
records.text: Get @NumRecombobulator@ Pocket Recombobulators, a consumable that transforms a 1 or 2-cost champion into one of a higher cost. They keep their Star level. Also receive @NumReforgers@ Reforgers.

records.name: Augmented Power
records.text: Your next augment is one tier higher.

records.name: Prismatic Destiny
records.text: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Protagonist
records.text: Gain a random 1-cost Champion Augment. After @TurnDelay@ turns, gain a copy of the champion at the start of every turn.

records.name: Psychic Forge
records.text: Round start Completed Items on benched champions turn into one of their recommended items. Gain a random completed item.

records.name: Pyromaniac
records.text: Gain a Red Buff. Your Burns deal @BurnIncrease*100@% increased damage.

records.name: Quality Over Quantity
records.text:
Champions holding exactly 1 item upgrade that item to Radiant. Champions holding Radiant items gain @BonusHealth*100@% Health. Gain @NumRemovers@ Magnetic Removers.

Thief's Gloves counts as multiple items.

records.name: Quiet Quitting
records.text: For the next @NumRounds@ player combats, you cannot use your shop. After, gain @Gold@ gold and a Completed Item Anvil.

records.name: Replication
records.text: Choose 1 of 3 components. For the next @RoundsOfBonusItems@ rounds, gain a copy of that component.

records.name: Reroll Transfer
records.text:
For every @AugmentRerollTracked@ unused Augment Reroll, gain @ShopRerollToGrant@ free shop rerolls. Gain @Gold@ gold.

Does not include the round this augment is selected.

records.name: Restart Mission
records.text: Remove all champions on your board and bench. Gain @3Cost@ random 2-star 3-costs, @2Cost@ 2-star 2-costs, and @1Cost@ 2-star 1-cost champion.

records.name: Retribution
records.text:
Gain @ItemCount@ Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain Precision and @CritChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance.

{{TFT_Keyword_Precision}}

records.name: Rigged Shop+
records.text: Your next shop and every @NumRolls@ shops will contain all 3-cost champions. Gain @Rerolls@ rerolls.

records.name: Savings Account
records.text:
After you earn @GoldRequired@ gold in interest, gain @GoldToGain@ gold. Your max interest is increased to @InterestCap@. Gain @GoldNow@ gold now.

Gold earned: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount_Tracker@

records.name: Seraphim's Staff
records.text: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants @IncreasedMana@ additional Mana Regen if its holder has @APThreshold@% or more Ability Power.

records.name: Shimmerscale Essence
records.text:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. In @combatnum@ rounds, gain a Gamblers Blade.

These items give gold as well as combat power.

records.name: Spear's Will
records.text: Your team gains @AD*100@% Attack Damage and @Mana@ Mana. Gain a B.F. Sword and a Tear of the Goddess.

records.name: Side Effects
records.text: When an ally is healed, they deal @HealConversionPct*100@% of the healing to their target as magic damage. Every @HealInterval@ seconds, allies heal for @HealPct*100@% of their max Health.

records.name: Silver Destiny
records.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Silver Destiny+
records.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Silver Destiny++
records.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Size Matters
records.text: Gain a Giant's Belt. After a champion starts combat with more than @HealthRequired@ max Health, gain a Warmog's Armor.

records.name: Slice of Life
records.text: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving @Max5Costs@ 5-cost champion.

records.name: Small Grab Bag
records.text: Gain @NumComponents@ random item components.

records.name: Solo Leveling
records.text: For the next @NumCombats@ combats, your team size is 1 but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain @XPPerKill@ XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain @NumComponents@ item components.

records.name: Speedy Double Kill
records.text:
Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain @GoldAmount@ gold.

Fates Championship, 2021

records.name: Spirit Link
records.text: Champions restore @BaseRegenBonus*100@% of their max Health every @RegenPeriod@ seconds. Increase the healing by @RegenPerMissingHP@% for every 10 missing player Health.

records.name: Spreading Roots
records.text: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Spreading Roots+
records.text: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: A Story of Seven
records.text:
Collect Golden Balls by defeating players in combat. Collect all @WinsPerReward@ for a reward, then restart the quest with more powerful rewards.

Gain a 2-star 1-cost champion to start your journey.

records.name: Subscription Service
records.text: Now and at the start of each Stage, open a Shop of 4 unique 4-cost champions and gain @GoldPerStage@ gold.

records.name: Survivor
records.text: Gain @InitialGold@ gold. After @PlayersDead@ players are eliminated, gain @Gold@ more gold.

records.name: Sweet Treats
records.text:
Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains @HealthPerItem@ Health for each item equipped on champions.

Health Gained: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SweetTreats_TeamHealth@

Magic N' Mayhem Tactician's Crown, 2024

records.name: Sword Overflow
records.text: Gain @NumItems@ B.F. Swords. Your B.F. Swords grant +@BonusStat*100@% Attack Speed.

records.name: Table Scraps
records.text: After the next @NumStages@ carousels, gain one champion that was not taken and its item. Gain @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Tactician's Kitchen
records.text: Gain a random Emblem. After @TurnDelay@ rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

records.name: Tesla Coil
records.text: Each of your allies with @MinItems@ items equipped emits @NumArcs@ arcs of lightning every @Frequency@ seconds, dealing @Stage2Damage@-@Stage6Damage@ magic damage based on stage.

records.name: Baron's Lair
records.text:
Gain a random Tank item. After @StartSeconds@ seconds of combat, your team gains @Stats@% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

TFT Paris Open, 2025

records.name: Blood Offering
records.text: Gain a Bloodthirster. Combat start: Allies holding Bloodthirsters lose @HPLossPercent*100@% Health but gain a @HPShieldPercent*100@% Health shield and @BonusAD*100@% Attack Damage and Ability Power.

records.name: The Golden Dragon
records.text:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up 2 team slots but gain @BonusHealth@ Health and @DurabilityPct*100@% Durability.

Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power.
Dragonlands Championship, 2022

records.name: The Tower
records.text: Gain a giant Training Dummy with increased Health (increases with Stage). Every @ZapInterval@ seconds, it zaps the @ZapCount@ nearest enemies dealing @MaxHealthPct*100@% max Health true damage.

records.name: Woven Magic
records.text:
Gain a random item component. Every @ManaPerComponent@ Mana your team spends grants an additional component (max @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_NumComponents@/@ComponentMax@).

Mana spent: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_TrackedMana@/@ManaPerComponent@

records.name: Thorn-Plated Armor
records.text: Gain a Bramble Vest. Your Bramble Vests deal @damageamp1*100@-@damageamp4*100@% more damage (based on Stage).

records.name: Time Skip
records.text: Disable your Shop for the next @PenaltyTurns@ rounds. Then gain @Experience@ XP.

records.name: Titanic Titan
records.text: Increase your current and max player Health by @Heal@. On carousel rounds you are released earlier, but are much slower.

records.name: Tomb Raider I
records.text: For the next @NumDead@ players eliminated, choose one of their completed items to keep.

records.name: Tomb Raider II
records.text: Gain @NumInitialItems@ completed item anvil. Every time a player is eliminated, choose one of their completed items to keep.

records.name: Deadlier Blades
records.text: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain @AD*100@% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

records.name: The Trait Tree
records.text: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: The Trait Tree+
records.text: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.

records.name: Treasure Hunt
records.text: Gain a locked chest each Stage between now and Stage @MaxNumChests@. Unlock each chest when you spend @GoldNeededPerChest@ gold on Shop rerolls. These chests persist until opened.

records.name: Trifecta I
records.text:
Gain @numunits@ @Tier@-cost champions.
Combat Start: @BuffedNumber@ random @Tier@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

records.name: Trifecta II
records.text:
Gain @numunits@ @Tier@-cost champions. Allies gain @TeamAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.
Combat Start: @BuffedNumber@ random @Tier@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

records.name: Twin Guardians
records.text: If you have exactly @NumUnits@ allies in your first row, grant them @BonusHealth@ bonus Health, @BonusAR@ Armor, and @BonusMR@ Magic Resist.

records.name: Two Much Value
records.text: Gain @FreeRerolls@ reroll for every @UnitCount@ unique 2-cost champions fielded last player combat. Gain @NumChampsToGrant@ 2-cost champions.

records.name: Two Tanky
records.text: When you field exactly 2 copies of a champion, they both gain @BonusHealth@ Health. When one copy dies, the other gains a @OnDeathPercHeal*100@% max Health Shield for @HealDuration@ seconds. When you 3-star, gain a 2-star copy.

records.name: Two Trick
records.text: Gain a random 2-star 2-cost and 2 random 2-star 1-cost champions.

records.name: Underdogs
records.text: Whenever your team has fewer allies alive than your opponent, regenerate @MissingHeal@% missing Health each second (Max: @HealCap@).

records.name: Warlord's Honor
records.text: Every round, your team gain @Stats@% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Champions start with @StartingStacks@ stack of this effect, and can stack up to @MaxStacks@ times.

records.name: Unlimited Power
records.text:
Gain a Nashor's Tooth, a Jeweled Gauntlet, a Needlessly Large Rod and a Magnetic Remover.

Useful for Magic Carries!

records.name: Upward Mobility
records.text: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain @Health@ Health and @Rerolls@ free rerolls whenever you level up.

records.name: Urf's Gambit
records.text: If you win your next player combat, gain a Spatula. If you lose, gain a Frying Pan. Gain a component anvil and @Gold@ gold now.

records.name: Wand Overflow
records.text: Gain @NumItems@ Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +@BonusStat*100@% Attack Speed.

records.name: Heart of Steel
records.text: Gain a Steadfast Heart. Every @SecondsPerGain@ seconds of combat its holder survives, Steadfast Heart gains additional @Health@ permanent max Health.

records.name: Warpath
records.text:
Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing @PlayerDamage@ player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.
(Current: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_Warpath_DamageCount@)

records.name: Water Lotus I
records.text: Your team gains @CritChance*100@% Critical Strike chance, and their Abilities can critically strike. If an Ability critically strikes, restore @ManaOnCrit@% of your Mana over @ManaDuration@ seconds.

records.name: Water Lotus II
records.text: Your team gains @CritChance*100@% Critical Strike chance, and their Abilities can critically strike. If an Ability critically strikes, restore @ManaOnCrit@% of your Mana over @ManaDuration@ seconds.

records.name: On a Roll
records.text: Whenever you star up a champion that you fielded last combat, gain @NumRolls@ free Shop rerolls. Gain @Gold@ gold.

records.name: We Stick Together
records.text:
Gain a random Emblem and a completed item anvil. Allies that share a trait with that Emblem gain @ASPercent@% Attack Speed. @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_WeStickTogether_Tooltip@

Into The Arcane Tactician's Crown, 2025

records.name: Win Out
records.text: When you reach level 9, immediately level to 10 and gain @RerollCount@ free Shop rerolls. Gain @InstantXP@ XP now.

records.name: Worth the Wait
records.text:
Gain a random @UnitTier@-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

Champion: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_WorthTheWait@

records.name: Worth the Wait II
records.text:
Gain @InitialCopies@ copies of a random @unittier@-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

Champion: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_WorthTheWait@
